title: Remove Comments
description: Remove C++ style block comments /* */ and line comments // from a list of source strings.
pseudocode:
1. let res = [], buffer = '', inBlock = false
2. for each line in source:
3.   for i = 0 to line.length - 1:
4.     if inBlock:
5.       if line[i..i+1] == '*/': inBlock = false, i++
6.     else:
7.       if line[i..i+1] == '/*': inBlock = true, i++
8.       else if line[i..i+1] == '//': break
9.       else: buffer += line[i]
10.    if !inBlock and buffer.length > 0: res.push(buffer), buffer = ''

steps.note: End of line, push 'ab' to result
